entries.saved_takeaway: Primary abstract/author README describe staged supervised graph training, varied hop/fanout sampling, selected full-model snapshots and residual weighted prediction aggregation. Pinned source confirms full GCN/Adam and selected raw-logit snapshots, but alternates samplers immediately and breaks at first plateau. Native aggregator has global learned model weights and tanh residual coefficient, with unused node-attention MLP.
entries.relationship_to_GNNM_and_extension: Near efficient staged graph-ensemble ancestry. Sampling changes/full-weight trajectory and learned fusion differ from one-time graph spectral cotangent-to-private-factor VJP expansion. Exact full-paper gradient/spectral algorithm is unresolved.
entries.attributed_prior_vs_open_gap: Attribute staged graph diversification and snapshot/residual fusion, without transferring reported large-graph efficiency or embedding-diversity theorem to the proposal. Source discrepancy prevents treating current repo as qualified native method reproduction.
entries.decisive_next_step: Preserve as attributed near prior. Resolve full paper/prose-code discrepancy in a separately versioned source amendment before any native FAGEL control. Do not alter fixed primary pooling or add a sampling/fusion grid to the present mechanism screen.

frozen_candidate_operation.continuation_pooling: Ordinary per-member CE continuation; fixed mean raw-logit pooling.
